title: Simple UI. Focused features.
body: Yo I love this calendar view (kinda wish we could have custom colors). The visualization of the streaks we’re holding is so motivating to see at a glance like this. Unlimited counters. Thank you for that. And the Face ID/ passcode privacy options 👍🏽 the app is simple and there’s very little time taken to familiarize ourselves with the UI. The features are focused and no extra bull. The app immediately integrated itself into my daily routine of reminding myself of the kind a person I want to become. Not to sound too cheesy.

title: So far so good
body:
It is nice to see how many days since i’ve left a habit behind. This is more convenient than writing it down in my opinion, because if rather than getting up, grab a notebook and write it down, you just open up your phone that you carry everywhere and see your progress. I put the app as a widget so i can easily see it. 
Besides that, there is a reset option and it counts the amount of resets you’ve done.
You can also choose the colour of the tracker which is nice.
There has been no problem for me so far.
